mapper.insert: /* SQL ID : DscsJoinUserDAO.ensureJoinUser 설명 : 토론 참여자 미존재 시 점수 덮어쓰기 없이 등록 */ MERGE INTO TB_LMS_DSCS_PTCP T USING ( SELECT #{stdId} AS USER_ID, #{dscsId} AS DSCS_ID FROM DUAL ) S ON (T.USER_ID = S.USER_ID AND T.DSCS_ID = S.DSCS_ID) WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( DSCS_PTCP_ID, USER_ID, DSCS_ID, TEAM_ID, SCR, EVLYN, RGTR_ID, REG_DTTM, MDFR_ID, MOD_DTTM, DELYN ) VALUES ( #{dscsPtcpId}, #{stdId}, #{dscsId}, #{teamId}, NULL, 'N', #{rgtrId}, FN_DTTM(), #{mdfrId}, FN_DTTM(), 'N' )
mapper.select: /* SQL ID : DscsJoinUserDAO.selectDscsJoinUser 설명 : 토론 참여자 단건 정보 조회 */ SELECT A.USER_ID AS stdId , A.DSCS_ID AS dscsId , NVL(A.SCR, 0) AS scr , A.EVLYN AS evlyn , A.RGTR_ID AS rgtrId , A.REG_DTTM AS regDttm , A.MDFR_ID AS mdfrId , A.MOD_DTTM AS modDttm , U.USER_ID AS userId , U.STDNT_NO AS stdntNo , U.USERNM AS userNm /* , U.DEPTNM AS deptNm */ /* 26.3.19 : Modify 부서명. */ , NVL(D.DEPTNM, '-') AS DEPTNM , (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_LMS_DSCS_ATCL B WHERE B.DSCS_ID = A.DSCS_ID AND B.DELYN = 'N' AND B.USER_ID = A.USER_ID) AS actlCnt , (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_LMS_DSCS_CMNT B WHERE B.DSCS_ATCL_ID IN (SELECT DSCS_ATCL_ID FROM TB_LMS_DSCS_ATCL WHERE DSCS_ID = A.DSCS_ID) AND B.DELYN = 'N' AND B.USER_ID = A.USER_ID) AS cmntCnt , (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_LMS_DSCS_FDBK B WHERE B.DSCS_ID = A.DSCS_ID AND B.USER_ID = A.USER_ID AND B.DELYN = 'N') AS dscsFdbkCnt FROM TB_LMS_DSCS_PTCP A LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_USER U ON A.USER_ID = U.USER_ID LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_DEPT D ON U.DEPT_ID = D.DEPT_ID WHERE A.USER_ID = #{stdId} AND A.DSCS_ID = #{dscsId}

/* SQL ID : DscsJoinUserDAO.dscsJoinUserList 설명 : 수강생 토론 성적 목록 조회 */ SELECT U.USER_ID AS stdId , U.DSCS_ID AS dscsId , NVL(SCR, 0) AS scr , EVLYN AS evlyn , U.RGTR_ID AS rgtrId , U.REG_DTTM AS regDttm , U.MDFR_ID AS mdfrId , U.MOD_DTTM AS modDttm , (SELECT NVL(USER_ID, S.USER_ID) FROM TB_LMS_USER WHERE USER_ID = S.USER_ID) AS userId FROM TB_LMS_DSCS_PTCP U JOIN TB_LMS_DSCS D ON U.DSCS_ID = D.DSCS_ID -- 토론 마스터 조인 JOIN TB_LMS_ATNDLC S ON U.USER_ID = S.USER_ID AND D.SBJCT_ID = S.SBJCT_ID -- 사용자 및 과목코드 일치 WHERE U.DSCS_ID = #{dscsId} AND S.ATNDLC_STSCD = 'APPROVE'

/* SQL ID : DscsJoinUserDAO.selectProfMemo 설명 : 교수 메모 팝업 정보 조회 */ SELECT D.DEPTNM AS deptNm , U.USER_ID AS userId , U.STDNT_NO AS stdntNo , U.USERNM AS userNm , NVL(A.SCR, 0) AS scr , B.SBJCT_ID AS sbjctId , A.PROF_MEMO AS profMemo FROM TB_LMS_DSCS_PTCP A /* 토론 정보 조인 */ LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_DSCS B ON A.DSCS_ID = B.DSCS_ID /* 2. 사용자 정보 조인 */ LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_USER U ON A.USER_ID = U.USER_ID /* 3. 학과 부서 정보 조인 (DEPT_ID 기준) */ LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_DEPT D ON U.DEPT_ID = D.DEPT_ID WHERE 1 = 1 AND A.USER_ID = #{stdId} AND A.DSCS_ID = #{dscsId}
